title: Summer Mistral outbreak, Gulf of Lion
notes: 4 Aug 2023: a sharp cold-air outbreak behind an Atlantic trough drove an out-of-season Mistral/Tramontane episode over the Gulf of Lion (gale-force NW flow after a very hot spell). Med bounds 38-48N/5W-15E clip the detector's Biscay ridge box (-8..-2E) to its eastern half — still >= 4 cells, so R-MISTRAL-01 evaluates on the clipped box; noted per §9 honesty. The combined rule may label the event 'tramontane'; that satisfies the expectation (same pattern, west channel). Confidence: moderate on the exact date; the case primarily exercises the regime rule on real fields.
